title: tier-2 shipped code: the character controller's step stage against 0x142cf5020
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/controller.rs (step_stage), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the controller_step_stage entry.

The oracle runs the real 0x142cf5020 - the character's step stage, a call-free leaf - and the harness compares the output position quad, the round count and the plane records' accumulated pushes byte for byte.
The plane array lives right after the variant block inside the block's own pointee and the block's +0x440 holds the arena address of the array, so the oracle dereferences the real records.
The epsilon is the client's own: MoverAdvance writes 0x3ba3d70a into the sweep block every frame.
acknowledgedGaps: This unit verifies the step stage only. The pair walk that fills the plane array (the face records at +0xc0 and +0x18, the count at +0xf6), the narrowphase that produces the resolve's factor and the solver's fixed point around them are separate reads.
